Secure Node Isolation Protocol

You are a network security engineer managing a hierarchical botnet detection tree with N nodes. For maximum coverage of the botnet while minimizing interference, you must select a subset of nodes for deployment of monitoring probes. Two directly connected nodes cannot simultaneously carry probes (they would interfere with each other).

You need to select the maximum number of monitoring nodes such that no two selected nodes are directly adjacent. Output the size of the maximum independent set.
explanation: Classic Tree DP. Define dp[v][0] = max independent set size in subtree of v, when v is NOT selected. Define dp[v][1] = max size when v IS selected. Recurrence: dp[v][1] = 1 + sum over children c of dp[c][0] (if v is selected, children cannot be). dp[v][0] = sum over children c of max(dp[c][0], dp[c][1]) (children can be either). Process nodes in post-order (leaves up to root) to fill the table. Answer = max(dp[root][0], dp[root][1]).
